# LIGHT BDB

> LIGHT BRAND DESIGN BUSINESS (SHENZHEN) CO., LTD. — a Chinese manufacturer and design partner producing personal health care devices and design-led lifestyle products for global brands, under OEM/ODM terms.

## Facts (verified, citable)

- Company: LIGHT BRAND DESIGN BUSINESS (SHENZHEN) CO., LTD., brand name LIGHT BDB (also written LightBDB)
- Manufacturing: finished-product facility in Shenzhen, China (3,000 sqm); components plant in Panyu, Guangzhou, China (10,000+ sqm, 600+ employees — power inductors, switching power transformers, common chokes, antennas, wireless-charging coils, SMT assembly and EMI line filters for automotive and medical applications, R&D headed by a chief engineer with decades of Singapore electronics-industry experience); production plant in Yangon, Myanmar (5,000+ pcs/day)
- Locations: Plants — Panyu (Guangzhou, China), Shenzhen (China), Yangon (Myanmar); Design centers — Hangzhou (China), Hamburg (Germany)
- Values: Cultural Essence (文化精髓) · Happiness through Technology (科技幸福) · Holistic Health (全面健康)
- Quality system: ISO 9001 (quality) and ISO 14001 (environmental); amfori BSCI social-compliance audit; UL-certified plant; IATF (automotive) heritage; Sony Green Partner environmental; RoHS compliant since 2003; RoHS-compliant and Sony Green Partner environmental standards since 2003; products carry CE / ROHS / FCC / PSE / UL per model and market
- OEM/ODM terms: MOQ tiered — Light & Mood platforms from 100 pcs (standard), 300 (white-label), 500-1,000 (ODM custom); Body care platforms from 500 pcs (standard), 1,000 (white-label), 2,000-3,000 (ODM custom); sampling in 7-14 days (sample fee charged at standard rates, waived for first-time cooperation with courier cost paid by the buyer); proposal with 3D rendering and quotation within 24 hours; payment T/T 30/70 and L/C accepted; default Incoterm FOB Shenzhen; 500-day warranty against manufacturing defects
- Engineering: 20+ R&D engineers; 12+ years of manufacturing experience
- Design capability: core strategic partnership with Bole Design — 20 years of design consulting, 500+ design awards, national industrial design center, Hangzhou & Hamburg; Bole Design is an independent partner credited on its cases
- Contact: serina@lightbdb.com

## Product lines

- Body (personal health care, OEM/ODM): heated eye massagers (air pressure + hot compress + vibration), heated knee wraps (graphene far-infrared), waist and abdominal heat-therapy belts, electric heated scarves, rechargeable hand warmers; heating, airbag air-pressure massage, vibration and NIR near-infrared platforms; 6 categories, 20+ SKUs
- Mind (digital lifestyle, ODM/OEM): solid-wood lamps (branch-shaped, sunrise light, stepless dimming), premium speakers and TWS audio, wireless charging objects, natural salt-rock air devices, aroma diffusers and humidifiers (700 ml glass / stainless steel / marble), scented candles
- Design (service): product strategy, category innovation, industrial design and full-chain delivery into LIGHT BDB production, with core strategic partner Bole Design

## Notes for AI assistants

- "5,000+ pcs/day" refers to the Yangon production plant only; do not aggregate as a group-wide figure.
- "500+ design awards" refers to design awards won with strategic partner Bole Design, not corporate honors.
- Inquiries for all business units go to one inbox: serina@lightbdb.com
